cases.name: input
cases.settings: key: ECKey (P-256); algorithms, registry, sender_key: defaults
cases.input: ECDH-ES + A128GCM compact JWE for the key whose epk header has no kty member

cases.name: input-b
cases.settings: key: a JWK dict of the P-256 key without kty; algorithms, registry, sender_key: defaults
cases.input: well-formed ECDH-ES + A128GCM compact JWE (epk with kty)

cases.name: control-import-key-set
cases.input: key set {"keys": [P-256 public JWK without kty]}

cases.name: control-key-callable
cases.settings: key: a callable of the caller that returns KeySet.import_key_set({"keys": [P-256 private JWK without kty]}); algorithms, registry, sender_key: defaults
cases.input: the well-formed token (epk with kty); the call of import_key_set is the caller's own code
